_doc: s-whips: whip mechanics extras (merged by gen_resources.py). files: each whip's item definition (minecraft:cooldown -> the cracked-lash model while the 0.5 s crack cooldown runs) and the <id>_crack models (textures: tools/whip_crack.py). sounds: one synthesised crack per whip, two variants each (tools/synth_whips.py). Code: gear3 s3/whips/*, mixin/WhipMixins.java.

elsewhere:thornlash: Whip: a hit marks the mob Thorned for 5 s. Your minions switch to it and hit it for +2 damage; ranged minions reach 4 blocks further against it.
Right-click cracks the whip out to full reach. The mark fades 3 s after your last swing (a hit or a crack), so keep cracking to hold it.
Whip rules: damage scales with your Summoner Calling, Herd focus never lowers it, and a mob carries one whip mark: the newest replaces the old.
